overrides.description: Per content kind: entry id -> fields shallow-merged onto the existing entry.

entry.description: Base entry. Kind definitions add typed fields; unknown extra fields are allowed so third-party packs can carry their own data. Rules fields hold SRD rules text only (no flavor).

count.description: Fixed number, derived from a trait modifier, equal to the character level, or Tier plus a base and/or trait (used for circles/boxes printed with rule text).

experience.description: The feature grants an Experience, added to the character's list and printed with the others. Give `start` for a fixed bonus, or `note` for one that follows something else (printed in place of +N).

perTier.description: Added at every tier achievement after the Experience is gained.

short.description: Condensed wording for the printed sheet; "" = print nothing (folded into the previous feature).

sheetCards.description: Items printed as their own blocks on the domain card sheet (e.g. poisons).

sheetTable.description: One column of a table printed across the top of the domain card sheet; the row names are shared by the subclass features.

experienceStart.description: Starting bonus for new Experiences (Android: 3 instead of 2).

extraSecondaryWeapon.description: The character may wield one more secondary weapon (Kasatha).

weapon.description: A natural weapon granted by the feature (claws, bite); printed as a weapon line using the character Proficiency.

countBox.description: A write-in count box with no upper limit, printed on the inventory header row (Scrapborn Junk Count).

tracker.description: Printed marks only, never stored. box = HP/Armor/Stress/frame counters; circle = uses tied to a trait.

statNote.description: Flags a headline stat this feature/card/item can change, that the printed sheet does not (and, for 'situational', cannot) bake into the number: a footnote symbol goes on the stat's label and on this entry's name, with `text` in the page's legend. 'build' = depends on the character's own gear/loadout, knowable from the sheet but not modelled (e.g. an Armor Score bonus while wearing armor); 'situational' = depends on what happens at the table (e.g. an Evasion bonus against one kind of attack).

choice.description: A choice the wizard asks the player.

frameOp.description: One ordered operation a campaign frame applies to character creation. Per-op fields are validated when frame packs are built (step 3).

short.description: Condensed wording for the printed sheet; "" = print nothing (folded into the previous feature).
Condensed wording for the printed sheet; "" = print nothing (folded into the previous feature).

onlyWith.description: Id of the campaign frame or supplement that must be selected for this class to be offered.

allowedCardTypes.description: Only domain cards of these types can be taken (Witchwarper: spell).

cardWords.description: Word swaps printed on this class's domain cards (whole words; plurals and capitals kept).

cardTypes.description: Card type relabels for this class (spell -> tech).

extraDomain.description: Domain this subclass adds, with one extra level 1 card from it at creation.

onlyWith.description: Id of the campaign frame or supplement that must be selected for this ancestry to be offered.
Id of the campaign frame or supplement that must be selected for this community to be offered.

group.description: Name of a group of supplements the start screen can check or uncheck together (Starheart - Starfinder Conversion).

ships.description: Starheart ship creation rules and ship domain cards (Series 14).

levelUpOption.description: A level-up rule: a tier achievement, a choosable advancement (slots per tier), a fixed per-level step, or a class-specific one (classId).

grants.description: While Available bonus: one extra Stress slot, or one extra Hull Point in a system.

reloadTokens.description: Reload Tokens the card holds (full on a new ship).

usesPer.description: Once-per use worth a printed checkbox.

tokens.description: Ship-wide tokens the card gains or spends (prints that tracker).

description.description: Shown in the creator only, never printed.

advancement.description: Ship refit advancement (Series 16): vault size, advancement options (boxes to check) and compartments.

base.description: Vault slots at no advancement (0: the loadout holds 7 cards, and every two checked boxes add one more card to the vault).

boxesPerExtraSlot.description: Checked boxes per extra vault slot (rounds down).

boxes.description: Boxes to check for this option.

boxesFromSize.description: True: boxes equal the ship's size number (compartments).

gains.description: The ways to take this option (the player picks one).

alternatesWith.description: Threshold options alternate with this one.

rollsOn.description: Consumable type this compartment rolls on.

domains.description: The two ship domains that give this archetype, either order.

items.description: Rules text with **bold** keywords and costs, *italic* conditions.

tokens.description: Ship-wide tokens the features use (prints that tracker).
